findings.title: WFP-supported commercial bakeries resume after flour shortage, with one still closed on 25 October
findings.location: Gaza Strip (specific bakery sites not identified)
findings.affected_population_or_system: Bread production and access; 17 WFP fuel-only supported commercial bakeries. Fourteen stopped 23 October; 16 operating by 25 October after temporary flour transfers; one remained closed for technical reasons.
findings.source_type: UN humanitarian coordination; WFP-supported sector reporting summarized by OCHA
findings.confidence: HIGH for OCHA-reported operational status; underlying flour flow requires WFP/operator confirmation

findings.title: OCHA reports only 47% of Gaza health service points at least partly functional amid critical oncology shortages
findings.affected_population_or_system: Hospitals, clinics, cancer diagnostics and chronic disease patients; 47% of health service points partly or fully functional, restricted IV fluids, anaesthesia, surgery supplies, type 1 insulin analogues, and limited mammography/CT with no MRI capability reported.
findings.source_type: UN humanitarian coordination; health-sector reporting with Gaza MoH oncology service figures
